greeting.text:
A troll sits in the cave mouth, knees up, his big hands round his shins. There's no way past him. His red eyes follow you.

"Oh. Someone's stopped. Not many do."

cave.text: "Dark, mostly. Water. Fish with no eyes. It goes a long way under the hill, and then it stops."

why.text: "The stone's cool and it's quiet. And on still nights I hear them playing at the fires, down the valley. Just a bit of it. The wind takes the rest."

music.text: "I'd give a lot to hear a tune all the way through. Nobody'll come up here and play one, though. They see me and they turn round."

in.text:
He doesn't move.

"Not for nothing. Play me a tune, a whole one, all the way through, and I'll shift. Bring friends if you like. More the better."
